fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Bifacial Single-Diode + Lumped Thermal ODE
source: De Soto et al. (2006), Solar Energy 80(1); Marion et al. (2017) NREL bifacial view-factor model; Faiman (2008) module thermal model; Jain & Kapoor (2004) Lambert-W single-diode solution

module.name: LG NeON 2 BiFacial 400W (n-type mono-Si bifacial)
module.source: Typical n-type mono-Si bifacial module datasheet

rear_view_factor.note: Geometric view factor: fraction of albedo-reflected light reaching rear (tilt/height/layout dependent), Marion 2017

desoto_params.description: De Soto 5-parameter single-diode coefficients at STC (front-side equivalent)
desoto_params.source: Fitted from LG NeON 2 BiFacial 400W datasheet

a_ref.note: Modified ideality factor n*Ns*Vt at STC

thermal.description: Lumped (0D) module thermal mass for transient cell-temperature ODE
thermal.source: Faiman (2008) Prog. Photovolt. 16; Jones & Underwood (2001) Solar Energy 70

C_thermal.note: Areal heat capacity of glass-cell-backsheet stack (~11 kg/m2 glass-dominated, cp~840)

absorptance.note: Effective solar absorptance of module (fraction of G converted to heat budget)

valid_ranges.note: STC = 1000 W/m2 front, 25C cell temp. Rear irradiance given directly OR computed as albedo*G_front*rear_view_factor (Marion 2017 view-factor approximation).
